name: 景山公园
experience_value: Provides the visual release after a dense imperial landmark block.
Works as a short but high-payoff transition from palace scale to open skyline memory.
Gives couple and solo routes a controlled scenic climax without requiring a full additional district.
avoid_when: the route already has too many scenic lookouts in one day
the plan needs a deeply local neighborhood slice instead of a symbolic viewpoint
summer midday exposure would make the stop feel like transit rather than payoff
